# SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3

The unmodified ECMAScript module `xlsx-0.20.3.mjs` is vendored so importing
Excel files does not require a CDN or disclose the file to another service.

- Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs
- License: Apache License 2.0, included in `SheetJS-LICENSE.txt`
- Official installation documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
- Downloaded: 2026-10-08

The budget importer reads cell values, rejects formulas in imported fields,
and does not execute workbook macros, formulas, or external links.
